summary: Birmingham City Council's planning portal (eplanning.birmingham.gov.uk/Northgate/PlanningExplorer) is UNREACHABLE from this environment: the pre-configured agent proxy gateway answers "403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)" for eplanning.birmingham.gov.uk, www.birmingham.gov.uk, acp.planninginspectorate.gov.uk, planit.org.uk, planningfinder.co.uk, r.jina.ai, and even direct google.com/bing.com/duckduckgo.com — confirmed via curl through $HTTPS_PROXY and via WebFetch (both return 403; proxy status log shows repeated "connect_rejected ... gateway answered 403 to CONNECT" entries for these hosts). The ONLY working channel was the hosted WebSearch tool (server-side, US-indexed). Using it exhaustively (address searches, ref-number searches, site: searches of the portal and of birmingham.gov.uk weekly-list PDFs, aggregator searches): (1) NO planning records for 115 Vicarage Road B14 7QG could be found in any index — S/03404/05/FUL is not verifiable online (2005 records exist only inside the blocked portal; indexed weekly PDF lists start ~Jan 2025), and no record of the two-storey side extension over the garage was found (likely pre-digitisation); notable: 115 sold 7 April 2025 for £430,000, marketed by Robert Oulsnam as a "three bedroom LINK detached" with garage/store — a possible tension with the pre-app's "detached" description worth checking. (2) No indexed planning history for 111, 113 or 117 Vicarage Road (sale dates only: 113 sold Jul 2009 £215k; 111 sold Feb 2023 £367.5k). (3) The refused-then-approved "high-level windows + roof lantern" case in the 100-130 range was NOT found; the closest documented activity is 131 Vicarage Road B14 7QQ with householder application(s) received w/c 10 Aug 2025 — 2025/04397/PA "erection of first floor rear extension" and 2025/04448/PA (reported variously as first floor front or rear extension; both refs appear against the 10-16 Aug 2025 weekly list PDF), decisions unknown. This 131 first-floor-rear application is the best candidate for the owner's "neighbours have first-floor rear extensions" claim on the same street. (4) Nothing indexed for Taylor Road / Barn Lane / Woodthorpe Road B14 two-storey rear extensions 2025-26. (5) No Vicarage Road B14 appeal decisions found; nearest Birmingham S appeal located was APP/P4605/W/25/3372225 (230A Grange Road, Moseley & Kings Heath — allowed, change of use of builders yard, not relevant as extension precedent). Two orphan portal refs surfaced under a "B14 7QG" site-query (2011/00180/PA, 2014/06692/PA) that could not be tied to an address and should be checked on the portal from an unrestricted connection. Bottom line: full verified planning histories require portal access outside this proxied environment (or a call to BCC Planning, 0121 303 1115); the specific refs to pull first are S/03404/05/FUL, 2025/04397/PA, 2025/04448/PA, 2011/00180/PA, 2014/06692/PA and the side-extension permission for 115 (address search, pre-2005).

facts.detail: eplanning.birmingham.gov.uk (Northgate PlanningExplorer) is blocked by the environment's agent proxy: curl through $HTTPS_PROXY returns 'curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' and WebFetch returns 'HTTP 403 Forbidden'. Proxy status endpoint logs 'connect_rejected — gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)' for eplanning.birmingham.gov.uk, www.birmingham.gov.uk, www.solihull.gov.uk and acp.planninginspectorate.gov.uk. Also blocked: planit.org.uk, planningfinder.co.uk, r.jina.ai, html.duckduckgo.com, www.bing.com, www.google.com, webcache.googleusercontent.com. The portal itself is presumably fine — the denial is at the proxy gateway.
facts.value: Portal unreachable — proxy policy denial (403 to CONNECT)

facts.detail: No planning application for 115 Vicarage Road B14 7QG appears in any web index searched (exact-phrase searches of birmingham.gov.uk weekly-list PDFs Jan 2025-Jul 2026, eplanning site: searches, aggregators). No record found of the two-storey flat-roof side extension over the garage (no ref, date, dims or conditions obtainable) — likely pre-dates online records. No post-pre-app 2026 submission for 115 appears in indexed weekly lists through 25 Jul 2026.

facts.detail: Sold 7 April 2025 for £430,000 (themovemarket property page for 115 Vicarage Road B14 7QG — an earlier search summary mis-attributed this sale to No.117). Marketed by Robert Oulsnam as a 'three bedroom LINK detached residence' with living room, dining room, kitchen, downstairs WC, garage/store, off-road parking; opposite Kings Heath Park and Camp Hill School; Council Tax Band E. The 'link detached' description is a possible tension with the pre-app officer's 'detached' characterisation and with subservience arguments — verify.

No planning applications for 111, 113 or 117 Vicarage Road B14 7QG found in any index. Sale data only: 113 (4-bed period house) sold £215,000 Jul 2009; 111 sold £367,500 Feb 2023. The claimed full-width first-floor rear extension at 111/113 and 117's conservatory permission (if any — conservatories are usually permitted development) cannot be verified without portal access.

facts.topic: 131 Vicarage Road B14 7QQ — nearest documented street precedent
facts.detail: Householder application(s) received week 10-16 Aug 2025, Brandwood & King's Heath ward: ref 2025/04397/PA described as 'erection of first floor rear extension' and ref 2025/04448/PA described in one reading as 'first floor front extension' and in another as 'first floor rear extension' — both refs cited against the same weekly PDF (birmingham.gov.uk download id/30667); may be two applications (front + rear) or one summarisation error. Decisions NOT ascertainable (weekly lists are received-lists only). This is the strongest candidate for (a) the owner's 'neighbours in line' first-floor rear precedent and possibly (b) the refused-then-revised case — 131 is on the odd side a few doors up from 115. Pull both refs first on the portal.

facts.detail: Not found in any index. No refusal, appeal or re-approval on Vicarage Road B14 7QG/7QQ is indexed. If it exists it is only visible on the portal (address search of each number 100-131) — recommend checking 131 (2025/04397/PA / 2025/04448/PA) first since a first-floor application there in Aug 2025 followed by nothing indexed could mask a refusal-and-resubmission sequence.

facts.topic: Adjoining streets (Taylor Rd, Barn Lane, Woodthorpe Rd B14)
facts.detail: No two-storey/first-floor rear extension approvals on these streets appear in indexed weekly lists 2025-2026 or portal-indexed pages. Absence of evidence only — the received-lists are indexed patchily by Google and decisions lists are not indexed at all.

No Planning Inspectorate appeal decisions for Vicarage Road B14 found. Nearest located Birmingham appeal: APP/P4605/W/25/3372225, 230A Grange Road, Moseley & Kings Heath (Mr M Puopolo v Birmingham CC) — ALLOWED, change of use of builders yard to residential incl. extensions; not an extension-design precedent. acp.planninginspectorate.gov.uk itself is proxy-blocked so full-text appeal searching was impossible.

Google's index of eplanning.birmingham.gov.uk surfaced two application detail pages in response to a '"Vicarage Road" "B14 7QG"' site-query that could not be resolved to an address without portal access: 2011/00180/PA (PARAM0=494483) and 2014/06692/PA (PARAM0=670375). They may relate to Kings Heath Park/other Vicarage Road properties rather than No.115, but should be pulled when the portal is accessible. Also indexed: 2015/01188/PA = 1 Vicarage Road B14 7QA (change of use A2 to C3, approved with conditions 30 Apr 2015 — not relevant as massing precedent).

facts.detail: From an unrestricted connection: (1) eplanning.birmingham.gov.uk/Northgate/PlanningExplorer/GeneralSearch.aspx — address-search each of 100-131 Vicarage Road B14, plus Taylor Rd/Barn Lane/Woodthorpe Rd; (2) pull refs S/03404/05/FUL, 2025/04397/PA, 2025/04448/PA, 2011/00180/PA, 2014/06692/PA and decision notices + approved drawings (dims are on the drawings, not the register entry); (3) planit.org.uk API (search=Vicarage Road, auth=Birmingham) gives the whole street's history in one JSON call; (4) acp.planninginspectorate.gov.uk CaseSearch for LPA P4605 + 'Vicarage Road'; (5) BCC Planning enquiries 0121 303 1115 / planning.enquiries@birmingham.gov.uk for the pre-2000 side-extension permission (paper microfiche era).
